statement: A nontorsion elliptic extension by Gm has endomorphism ring Z. For E361 and Q=2P the compact slope c=zeta(u)-eta1*u/omega1 is real transcendental; hypothetical algebraic N gives an algebraic compact lift on a Lie line not defined over Qbar. Functional Ax-Schanuel gives the full three-dimensional graph and no contradiction.
